sources.entry: bottle - A fast and simple micro-framework distributed as a single file with no dependencies.

summary.one_liner: Bottle is a fast, simple, lightweight WSGI micro web framework for Python, distributed as a single file with no dependencies beyond the standard library.
summary.what_it_does: Maps URLs to Python functions with support for clean and dynamic routes. It includes a built-in template engine and supports mako, jinja2, and cheetah templates. It provides convenient access to form data, file uploads, cookies, and headers. It has a built-in development server and adapters for WSGI-capable servers such as gunicorn, paste, and cheroot. A minimal app can be a few lines: define a route with a decorator, then call run().
use_cases: building small web apps or APIs
embedding a web app in a single file
deploying a Python web app behind gunicorn or similar WSGI servers
how_to_run: Or download bottle.py into your project directory
from bottle import route, run, template
notable: Distributed as a single file module with no hard dependencies
Built-in template engine plus support for mako, jinja2, and cheetah
Adapters for multiple WSGI-capable HTTP servers
caveats: The README does not state platform or Python version limits
The single-file download is described as unstable; the pip release is the stable option
